evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies outbound message validation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Prevents V2 transport buffer overruns and V1 transport aborts by enforcing message type and payload bounds on outbound traffic before queuing. Commit 4b10305dee notes that 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 can overwrite the first payload byte or write past its encoding buffer', eliminating a dangerous failure mode in transport serialization.
